result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='*SalesRepPurchaseOrder*'` and it passed. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, and I didn't run the full suite or check your Anna and Bob example against the data.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the purchase-order subquery, the same filter the quarter and weekday reports use. I also updated the method's Javadoc to say cancelled orders are left out.

I didn't touch the ordering or the zero-count rows, so reps with no purchase orders are still listed with 0, highest count first. Nothing is committed.
